tools.name: get_nearest_stations
tools.description: Find the nearest EV charging stations to a latitude/longitude, optionally filtered by speed, power or live availability. Stations whose verified owner is on Listed Pro come first, then by distance. Each station has verified_owner and owner_profile.

tools.name: get_station_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific EV charging station by its ID.

tools.name: get_city_charging_stats
tools.description: Get EV charging statistics for a specific city including station count, network breakdown, and top stations.

tools.name: get_state_charging_stats
tools.description: Get EV charging statistics for a US state including station count, cities, network breakdown.

tools.name: find_stations_on_route
tools.description: Find EV charging stations along a route defined by a series of waypoints. Useful for trip planning. Searches within a corridor around the route. Within each route segment, stations whose verified owner is on Listed Pro come first. Each station has verified_owner and owner_profile.
